name: beautijoo
description: Beautijoo - Persian RTL marketplace and booking platform for beauty professionals

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && rm -rf ../.next ../public && cp -a .next ../.next && mkdir -p ../.next/standalone/.next && cp -a .next/static ../.next/standalone/.next/static && mkdir -p ../.next/standalone/public && if [ -d public ]; then cp -a public/. ../.next/standalone/public/; fi && mkdir -p ../public && if [ -d public ]; then cp -a public/. ../public/; fi && test -f ../.next/standalone/server.js
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
